rules.statement: A broker who introduces to his principal a person who is able and willing to enter into the contract is entitled to his commission, even if the negotiations should fall through owing to circumstances over which the broker has no control.
rules.supporting_quote: "It has been held in a variety of English cases that where it is agreed that an agent shall be paid a certain commission in the event of his finding a purchaser for the property, it is sufficient, as a general rule, if he procures a complete and binding contract which is accepted by the principal, although the transaction is never completed."
